items.question: What is Accomp?
items.answer: Accomp is a mobile app concept for planning outdoor trips together. It brings the itinerary, companions, shared gear, important details, and offline preparation into one trip space.

items.question: Can everyone help plan the same trip?
items.answer: The planned experience lets invited companions view and contribute to shared trip details. Exact collaboration controls will be confirmed before launch.

items.question: Can I use Accomp without a signal?
items.answer: Accomp is being designed around offline readiness, including prepared maps and essential trip information. Final offline capabilities will be announced before launch.

items.question: Who is Accomp for?
items.answer: Accomp is designed for hiking groups, backpackers, campers, weekend adventurers, and friends who want one clear plan before heading outdoors.

items.question: Will Accomp be available on iOS and Android?
items.answer: Platform availability has not been confirmed yet. This site will be updated when the release plan is ready.

items.question: When will Accomp launch?
items.answer: A launch date has not been announced. The waitlist shown here remains a design preview until a consented signup system is available.

items.question: Is Accomp free?
items.answer: Pricing has not been announced. Confirmed product and launch details will appear here before release.

roadmap.metaDescription: Follow the Accomp marketing website journey from project kickoff through its current bilingual roadmap phase.
roadmap.title: Every trail mark that brought us here.
roadmap.lede: A clear look at how the Accomp marketing website grew from an outdoor-app idea into a bilingual, release-ready product story.
roadmap.curatedNote: A curated public history · Updated as each phase is completed
roadmap.visualLabel: An illustrated trail connecting Accomp project milestones
roadmap.visualCaption: One shared direction, shaped one phase at a time.
roadmap.timelineBody: Each phase had one focused purpose: define the story, shape the experience, build it carefully, and make every release safer.
roadmap.currentNote: You are here — this is the current project phase.
roadmap.nextBody: Future phases will appear here only after their scope is approved. For now, explore the Accomp product story and the outdoor planning experience it is designed to support.

kickoff.title: Setting the trailhead
kickoff.summary: We defined Accomp as a marketing-only website for a future mobile companion that helps groups prepare for outdoor trips together.
highlights: Recorded the first brand and product assumptions

phase11.title: Finding the voice and visual direction
phase11.summary: We shaped the brand story, content hierarchy, pine identity, outdoor palette, and the first visual system for Accomp.
highlights: Defined the product promise and audience
Planned the content, motion, and design tokens

phase12.title: Turning the story into a journey
phase12.summary: We translated the strategy into page structure, responsive wireframes, and an interaction prototype that made the complete story testable.

phase13.title: Bringing the experience into focus
phase13.summary: We developed the high-fidelity visual language, including the offline map treatment, component states, and motion specifications.

phase14.title: Laying a reliable foundation
phase14.summary: We created the runnable project, converted the visual direction into design tokens, and built reusable layout and interface primitives.

phase15.title: Building the complete product story
phase15.summary: We assembled the responsive marketing page with the hero, feature chapters, offline story, FAQ, waitlist preview, and footer.
highlights: Added accessible mobile navigation and FAQs
Connected content to a typed model

phase16.title: Adding motion with purpose
phase16.summary: We introduced progressive movement that supports the story without getting in the way of reading, navigation, or reduced-motion preferences.
highlights: Animated the hero and route narrative

phase17.title: Improving discovery, trust, and speed
phase17.summary: We prepared search and social metadata, honest legal status pages, a branded not-found route, and performance checks.

phase18.title: Testing every important path
phase18.summary: We reviewed the experience across target screen sizes and strengthened touch targets, contrast, focus behavior, and release documentation.

phase19.title: Preparing a safe launch path
phase19.summary: We added automated quality checks, production-origin validation, security headers, and a deployment handoff that keeps owner approvals explicit.

phase110.title: Making releases repeatable
phase110.summary: We created a production smoke-test matrix and a clean-commit release package with a verifiable manifest.

phase21.title: Welcoming Thai and English audiences
phase21.summary: We moved every user-facing message into matched translation catalogs and introduced locale-aware routes, switching, metadata, and tests.
highlights: Added complete TH and EN catalogs
Expanded bilingual SEO and regression coverage

phase22.title: Making the journey visible
phase22.summary: We turned the project history into this bilingual roadmap so every completed phase and its contribution can be understood at a glance.
highlights: Connected bilingual navigation, SEO, and tests

privacy.metaDescription: Current privacy and data-handling status for the Accomp marketing website.
privacy.title: Privacy at Accomp.
privacy.lede: This page records how the pre-launch marketing website currently handles information.
privacy.noticeBody: This is an operational privacy notice for the current preview, not the final policy for the Accomp mobile app.

sections.title: Information collection
sections.body: The current website does not accept waitlist submissions, create accounts, process purchases, or ask visitors to provide personal information.

sections.title: Analytics and cookies
sections.body: Accomp has not enabled analytics, advertising trackers, or application cookies on this website. Because there are no optional cookies, no consent banner is shown.

sections.title: Future changes
sections.body: Before any form, analytics service, or optional cookie is activated, this notice will be replaced with an approved privacy policy and an appropriate consent experience.

sections.title: Contact readiness
sections.body: A verified legal entity and public privacy contact have not been supplied yet. Both remain release requirements before personal information can be collected.

terms.metaDescription: Current preview terms and product-status notice for the Accomp marketing website.
terms.title: A clear pre-launch status.
terms.lede: These terms explain the limited role of the current Accomp marketing preview.
terms.noticeBody: The Accomp app has not launched, so this page does not create an app account, subscription, purchase, or service relationship.

sections.title: Website purpose
sections.body: This website introduces the Accomp mobile app concept and its intended direction. It is informational and does not currently provide the app itself.

sections.title: Illustrative content
sections.body: App interfaces, trip information, readiness states, maps, and dates shown on the site are illustrative. Product capabilities, platforms, pricing, and launch timing remain subject to confirmation.

sections.title: No submissions or transactions
sections.body: The waitlist control is disabled. The website does not accept personal information, payments, bookings, or user-generated content.

sections.title: Release requirement
sections.body: Final terms, a verified legal entity, and a public contact must be approved before Accomp offers a live service or accepts a registration.
